audit_metadata.scope: L4 Pattern Demos (6 files across 4 domains: Input, Navigation, Data, Feedback, Layout)

surface_colors.notes: Surface variants used but limited to primary

border_colors.notes: Implicit in controls, not explicitly shown

icon_colors.notes: ZERO explicit icon color token usage

critical_gaps: sys.energy.icon.* tokens exist but demos never show icon color customization
Surface variant palette incomplete: only variant="primary" shown; accent/danger/success surfaces absent
No color-blind safe contrast examples

font_families.notes: Implicitly used via Text component only

critical_gaps: Composite voice styles (display-xl through display-xs) not exercised in any demo

All 4 size tiers demonstrated in size variant sections

responsive_gap_scaling.notes: No demos of gap changing per density tier

maxWidth values hardcoded ("600px", "500px") instead of using sys.frame.content tokens (dialog: 480px, prose: 680px)

shadow_tokens.notes: Not explicitly shown, available in CSS

overlay_opacities.notes: Correct overlay use in Surface patterns
